# `applied_customer_billing_rate`

Area: **billing** ([all tables](README.md))

SID AppliedCustomerBillingRate, ABR (TMF678 appliedCustomerBillingRate): a recurring charge for the billable days of one cycle period, or the one refund of such a charge. Written only by a billing run.

## Columns

| Column | Type | Null | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | `uuid` | no | `gen_random_uuid()` | Primary key, generated by the database (gen_random_uuid()). |
| `created_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | When the row was inserted: the database's now(), not the injected clock. Never used for billing decisions. |
| `updated_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no | `now()` | Last change: the database's now(), maintained by the set_updated_at trigger. |
| `product_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The product billed; null exactly for a oneTime rate (a transfer fee). |
| `billing_account_id` | `uuid` | no |  |  |
| `charge_type` | `charge_type` (enum, see [README](README.md#enums)) | no |  | recurring (TMF678 appliedBillingCharge, amount >= 0), refund (appliedBillingCredit, amount < 0) or oneTime (appliedBillingCharge: a transfer fee, amount > 0, one day, no product). |
| `amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no |  | numeric(12,2), exact (never float); TMF678 taxExcludedAmount: price x billable days / period days, rounded once half-even. Refunds are negative. |
| `currency` | `character(3)` | no |  | ISO 4217 code, three upper-case letters. Always the account's currency (composite foreign key). |
| `period` | `daterange` | no |  | TMF678 periodCoverage: daterange [start, end) of the days charged (or refunded), always inside one cycle period. |
| `billing_run_id` | `uuid` | no |  | The billing run that wrote it; its run_date is the ABR's run date. |
| `customer_bill_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The bill that collected it; NULL = not yet billed (TMF678 isBilled false). |
| `refunds_rate_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | On a refund: the charge it refunds (same product; one refund per charge). |
| `applied_at` | `timestamp with time zone` | no |  | TMF678 date: when the ABR was written - the injected clock of the billing run's attempt that wrote it (the instant that run issues its bills at), not the database's now(). |
| `applied_tax` | `jsonb` | no | `'[]'::jsonb` | TMF678 appliedTax: [{taxCategory, taxRate (percent; 0 = exempt), taxAmount}], one per tax item of the price, in its order. |
| `tax_amount` | `numeric(12,2)` | no | `0` | Money. The sum of applied_tax amounts; amount + tax_amount = taxIncludedAmount. |
| `product_offering_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The offering the ABR bills (a refund: its charge's). Billing sets it; an insert without one gets the product's offering on the first day of period. Null exactly for a oneTime rate. |
| `balance_action_id` | `uuid` | yes |  | The transfer whose fee this oneTime rate is (one fee per transfer); null otherwise. |
